notes: Rule 3 check: genuine XXXLutz (Impressum shows XXXLutz KG, Amtsgericht Wuerzburg HRA 6804 / HRB 8556, Trusted Shops certified); large live multi-category furniture/home retailer, not a scam/liquidation domain. Access: xxxlutz.de is Cloudflare-protected (managed challenge on cold/default-fingerprint requests); curl_cffi impersonation with chrome120/chrome131/chrome124/firefox135/safari17_0 profiles (rotated per request, ~5 retries) reliably reached the SSR HTML, which embeds a full GraphQL/Apollo state including a 'pagination' block (pageSize/totalPages/totalResults) for every product-listing URL. Category tree built from sitemap-categories.xml (5659 URLs; hierarchical C<id>C<id>... breadcrumb codes decoded to a tree; query-string facet variants such as ?p_color=/?pa_material=/?ec_brand= stripped out as non-canonical facet re-cuts, not separate categories). qty = SSR 'totalResults'; verified per-row via the cheap ceil(totalResults/pageSize)==totalPages exhaustion check (pageSize=60 stable across all 158 leaf fetches, no A/B page-size drift observed) -- all 157 verifiable leaves passed. Rule 0 applied: Lighting > Lighting by Room fully expanded (dining/bedroom/living/hallway/bathroom/kitchen/office/nursery/staircase), all bathroom and vanity/makeup mirrors and bathroom lighting kept in scope, lamp shades and under-cabinet lighting kept in scope. Excluded per rules: light bulbs/LED-lampen (E27/E14/GU10) and smart bulbs, motion sensors (pure sensor hardware), lamp feet/bases (spare-part hardware), all bathroom furniture/storage/plumbing/hardware under badezimmer and badaccessoires (kept only badspiegel + beleuchtete-spiegel, both mirrors/lighting), flatware/cutlery, bar tools, kitchen tools (egg cups, spice mills, serving spoons), functional insulated bottles/flasks (thermoskannen, trinkflaschen), all seasonal/holiday decor (Christmas/Easter/spring/autumn-Halloween trees under dekoration-C22), gift wrap, home fragrance (raumduefte/diffuser), craft supplies, pinboards, artificial/dried flowers and plants (kunstblumen/kunstpflanzen/trockenblumen/giesskannen) -- kept uebertoepfe (decorative planters) as its own product type per the 'decorative planters & pots' inclusion. Candle scent verified by reading actual product titles per-category (Rule: exclude scented): stumpenkerzen and dreidochtkerzen sampled titles show no 'Duft' (unscented) so kept; duftkerzen dropped outright (name = scented candle); kerze-im-glas dropped after sampling showed ~90% of titles literally begin 'DUFTKERZE' (scented). Rule 0.6 overlap documented: 'LED Lighting' (84.3: LED ceiling/wall/table/floor/pendant/desk/spot/panel/strip) is a genuine sibling top-level nav branch alongside 'Indoor Lighting' (84.1) and 'Outdoor Lighting' (84.2) on the site's own category page (both shown together in the sidebar of lampen-leuchten-C84) -- it is a technology-based tree, not a pure facet re-cut, so both are emitted per row-of-doubt guidance; LED fixture types materially overlap the equivalent Indoor Lighting fixture-type nodes (e.g. LED Ceiling Lights vs Ceiling Lights). One leaf (Staircase Lighting / treppenbeleuchtung-C84C1C15C9) returned only the client-side SPA shell with no SSR product data across a 9-profile curl_cffi sweep plus r.jina.ai (403), translate.goog (403) and WebFetch (403) -- set to qty null with a MANUAL REVIEW flag rather than guessed; every other Lighting-by-Room sibling URL rendered normally, so this looks like either a near-empty category or a one-off SSR edge case, not a site-wide block.
